rows.text: The LDP's history page for the 宮沢喜一 presidency says that on 十月二十七日 (27 October 1991), in the LDP presidential election held in the eighth-floor hall of party headquarters, 宮沢喜一氏 was chosen as the 15th president (第十五代総裁に選ばれました) in a three-way contest with 渡辺美智雄 and 三塚博: 宮沢 285, 渡辺 120, 三塚 87.
The page's second-to-last body paragraph (26 of 27, beginning 宮沢内閣の後には) says the LDP's new president, 河野洋平氏, took office (就任しました) on 七月三十日 (30 July 1993).
